MESSAGE: Today is a very peasful day to give you a tour around my village!
Hahaha! But of course, always remember there are laws..
But do not worry, I am here to guide you ^^
Woah, okay! I'm glad you like it ^^
BUT WAIT! Sorry.. but you can not stay here :8
UH weeeeell, if you want to have this kind of village..
All you need to is listen and play!
For now... this is YOUR village!
Do you remember the laws that I mentioned?
Soooo, there are three laws in this village..
Law of Segregation, Law of Dominance, and lastly, Law of Independent Assortment!
Now.. you may ask, what is the relation of these laws in building 'THE" village..
You see that chest over there?
So this is the 'Stages" where the laws are implemented.
And every finish stage is equivalent to a better village!
Again, all you need to do is listen and play!
Click the baskets if you're ready... :P
Soooo, for the first stage.. Law of Segregation is implemented.
All you need to is press the arrows to move the basket to catch the falling peas!
But! Only catch the YELLOW ones.. for catching the green ones can reduce your score (-1)..

MESSAGE: So.. for this game, the Law of Dominance is applied
All you need to is input the corresponding choice to the given question within the five second timer! ^^
For example, you are given two cards! One for dominant (D) and one for recessive (R)
And all you need to do is ALWAYS choose the color of the DOMINANT.
This is the first set of cards!
Choose what is the required color within five seconds!
WOW! CONGRATULATIONS FOR PASSING THE FIRST STAGE!
SInce you accomplished the stage, let me show you your "upgraded' village!
Hey! Look! We're here to your village!
SInce you accomplished the stage, the tent is replaced by a house!
No..? The house is broken and has holes?
Oh.. Well, don't worry! I GOT YOU! I know a way how to fix this :P
BUT! In order to fix this house of yours and improve this village, all you need to do is proceed with the second stage ^^
WOW! CONGRATULATIONS FOR PASSING THE SECOND STAGE!
SInce you accomplished the stage, let me show you your "upgraded' village!
Hey! Look! We're here to your village!
SInce you accomplished the stage, the previous houes is replaced by a bigger house!
Oh.. Well, don't worry! I GOT YOU! I know a way how to fix this :P
BUT! In order to fix this house of yours and improve this village, all you need to do is proceed with the LAST stage ^^
Click the cards to proceed with the second stage!
If you want to have the COMPLETE village, please click the square!
I know you can do it!
Welcome to the third and final stage!
So.. for this game, the Law of Independent Assortment  is applied
All you need to do is drag your chosen peas to their corresponding box within the five second timer! ^^
Question Number 1! Just touch the wrong pea in order for it to change!
Question Number 2! Just touch the wrong pea in order for it to change!
Question Number 3! Just touch the wrong pea in order for it to change!
WOW! CONGRATULATIONS FOR PASSING THE LAST STAGE!
Since you accomplished the last and final stage, let me show you your well deserved complete village!
Hey! Look! We're here to your village!
OMG! I am glad that you liked it… even though you did many things before getting this village
Now that you finished the stages, YOU ARE NOW FREE TO DO WHATEVER YOU WANT!
I HOPE YOU LIKED THIS GAME!
SEE YOU WHEN I SEE YOU ^^
